metadata.title: GPT-Image 2 Image to Image - Edit Posters, UI, and Photoreal Images | joymagic
metadata.description: Edit up to 4 uploaded images with GPT-Image 2 for Chinese poster cleanup, document-style layouts, photoreal retouching, and interface mockup transformations.
metadata.keywords: GPT-Image 2 image to image, chinese poster editing, photoreal image editor, UI mockup editor, image to image AI, edit up to 4 images

hero.title: GPT-Image 2 Image to Image
hero.description:
GPT-Image 2 image editing is especially strong when you need to revise text-heavy visuals, reshape document-like layouts, retouch photoreal scenes, or transform UI-style screenshots. You can upload up to 4 source images, describe the change in plain language, and keep the result aligned with the right aspect ratio.

Need to generate from scratch instead? Try GPT-Image 2 Text to Image.

features.title: Why GPT-Image 2 for image editing
features.description: A stronger editing workflow for text-aware layouts, photoreal refinements, and interface-style images.

references.title: Edit up to 4 images together

promptLed.title: Text-aware and layout-aware edits
promptLed.description: GPT-Image 2 is better suited to poster text, document structure, labels, and mixed visual layouts, making it useful for revision tasks that go beyond simple style swaps.

framing.title: Photoreal and UI-friendly output control
framing.description: Choose the final frame before generation so photo retouching, screenshot restyling, and composition changes land closer to the intended placement.

promptingTips.title: How to get better GPT-Image 2 edits

specific.title: Say what must change and what must stay
specific.description: For poster, document, and UI edits, be explicit about the text block, layout region, or visual element you want changed while keeping the rest intact.

batch.title: Keep one direction across the batch
batch.description: When uploading multiple images, use one clear instruction so the whole set stays in the same visual family and quality level.

framing.title: Choose the target ratio early
framing.description: Pick the final aspect ratio before generation so crop, spacing, and composition better match where the result will be used.

details.title: Call out realism or interface style
details.description: Mention whether you want photoreal retouching, film-like rendering, clean UI surfaces, or realistic screenshot behavior to steer the finish more precisely.

batchAssets.title: Poster and layout revision
batchAssets.description: Refresh Chinese posters, cover art, or document-like designs while preserving the core structure and improving clarity, balance, or text-heavy sections.

productRefresh.title: Photoreal product and portrait retouching
productRefresh.description: Refine lighting, texture, background mood, and finishing quality for product shots, portraits, or street-style photography without rebuilding the whole scene.

socialVariants.title: UI and screenshot restyling
socialVariants.description: Transform finance apps, desktop layouts, dashboards, and software screenshots into cleaner, sharper, or more cinematic interface visuals.

lookDev.title: Small-batch creative alignment
lookDev.description: Use a single prompt across up to 4 images to test one creative direction on a short asset set before moving into final production.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about GPT-Image 2 image editing for posters, photoreal scenes, and UI screenshots.

q1.question: How many images can I upload?
q1.answer: This GPT-Image 2 image-to-image workflow supports up to 4 uploaded images in a single run.

q2.question: What parameters are available?
q2.answer: The editor supports images, prompt, and aspect ratio. Aspect ratio includes 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 5:4, 4:5, 2:1, 1:2, 21:9, and 9:21.

q3.question: What kinds of edits is GPT-Image 2 especially good at?
q3.answer: It is especially useful for Chinese poster edits, document-style layouts, photoreal retouching, and UI or screenshot transformations where text, structure, and realism all matter.
